build_DDQDETR_detector: build a DDQDETR object detector model with dense distinct query selection for end-to-end object detection
init_DDQDETR_layers: initialize the DDQDETR transformer decoder and query mapping layers with configurable embed dimensions
init_DDQDETR_weights: initialize DDQDETR model weights using Xavier uniform for transformer and normal for level embeddings
run_DDQDETR_pre_decoder: run the pre_decoder method to prepare query, memory, and reference points before the transformer decoder
review_DDQDETR_dqs: review the DDQDETR distinct query selection mechanism using batched NMS for region proposal generation
